trie.title: Suffix Trie
trie.description: Inserts every suffix of T$ character by character. Simple to trace, with O(n²) worst-case nodes.
trie.viewportLabel: Suffix Trie diagram with {{nodes}} nodes and {{leaves}} leaves
trie.complexity: Build O(n²) time & space · Search O(m + occ)

tree.title: Suffix Tree
tree.description: Compresses unary chains into multi-character edge labels, bounding total nodes to at most 2(n+1).
tree.viewportLabel: Suffix Tree diagram with {{nodes}} nodes and {{leaves}} leaves
tree.complexity: Compressed trie MVP · ≤ 2(n+1) nodes · Search O(m + occ)

array.title: Suffix Array & LCP
array.description: Stores sorted suffix start indices plus Kasai's O(n) LCP array for compact O(n) indexing and binary search.
array.kasaiState: Kasai: i={{i}}, rank[i]={{rank}}, prev SA={{j}}, h={{h}}
array.complexity: Space O(n) integers · Kasai LCP O(n) · Search O(m log n)
